name: zsnd_wave_data_reset
description: zSndWaveData::Reset frees parsed WAV file data, clears parsed fields, and returns success.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the zSnd wave-data source target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a55c0 validates that Reset only performs work when parsedOk is set, frees non-null fileData, clears fileData/fileSize/pcmData/pcmByteCount/fmt/cuePointCount/cuePoints/parsedOk, and returns 1 unconditionally.

The native smoke loads a temporary PCM RIFF file through zSndWaveData::zSndWaveData, verifies parsed fields are populated, calls Reset, and verifies parsedOk, fileData, fileSize, fmt, pcmData, and pcmByteCount are cleared.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4a55c0 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches under vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs after 4 relocation-masked bytes; BN size 58, VC object symbol size 64, 6 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
